stops.note: to weigh, giving rise to pensare (to weigh carefully, frequentative of pendere)
to weigh together, to balance out, from com- and pensare
stops.meaning: to weigh together, to balance out

stops.note: settled as the English word for giving something to make up for a loss
stops.meaning: to give something to make up for a loss or harm

current_meaning: to give someone something, especially money, to make up for a loss or harm
